Main industry (NACE): 82.910 Inkasso- og kredittopplysningsvirksomhet. Registered employees: 66 (as of 2026-08-10). Latest filed annual accounts (2025, company statement): revenue NOK 109,719,372; operating result NOK 17,250,184; net result NOK 15,120,016; total assets NOK 81,890,588; equity NOK 33,873,189. Leadership: general manager (daglig leder) Aleksander Linge Ervik; board chair Svein Ove Kvalsund; 2 other board members. Sub-units registered: 7. Website: kravia.ai.
